files.version: Original print: Ruch Filozoficzny (ed. K. Twardowski, Lwow), 1920, issue nr 9, scan of the whole issue (printed pp. 153-176)
files.extent_note: Whole issue nr 9, printed pp. 153-176 continuous (PDF p.18 = p.170, p.19 = p.171). The note "O logice trojwartosciowej" (report of the 207th meeting of the Polish Philosophical Society, Lwow, 19 June 1920, Prof. Dr. Jan Lukasiewicz) runs from p.170 col. b to p.171 col. a and is complete. The preceding note on Lukasiewicz "O pojeciu mozliwosci" (206th meeting, pp. 169-170) is also present. NOT in this file: the English translation "On three-valued logic" (McCall 1967 pp. 16-18 / Borkowski 1970 pp. 87-88) named in the required extent; it remains unacquired and needs a separate acquisition.
